text: Sturdier than most spatulas being sold in stores.. nice angled spatula.  It feels nice in the hand, easy to grip and hold.  It's a little sturdier than the newer spatulas being sold everywhere.  Most of the plastic cooking utensils are flimsy.  This one is great!

product_metadata.title: Farberware Professional Heat Resistant Nylon, 12 inches, Black
features: ESSENTIAL AND DURABLE KITCHEN TURNER: The Farberware angled turner is an essential tool for the modern kitchen, its great for draining and flipping delicate foods.

HEAT RESISTANT: This angled turner features an oversized BPA-Free Nylon head that is heat resistant up to 450 degrees Fahrenheit; it is safe to use on all types of cookware including non-stick and coated.
NO MESS: The ergonomically designed handle is long to keep your hands away from the heat and is precisely weighted to elevate the head of the tool, keeping it off the countertop.
EASY TO CLEAN: Dishwasher safe, making clean up quick and easy.
LIFETIME LIMITED WARRANTY INCLUDED WITH PURCHASE: Never worry about the hassle of replacing a product, the Lifetime Limited Warranty is included with purchase.
description: This Farberware professional nylon short turner is an essential tool for the modern kitchen. The turner is heat-resistant up to 450 degrees Fahrenheit (232 degrees Celsius). this slotted turner is safe for all types of cookware, including non-stick. Featuring a tip up handle that raises the head up when resting on kitchen counters and an angled head making it easy to flip and mix your masterpeice. Dishwasher safe for simple and easy cleanup.
